full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white stippled illustration shows a woman crouching alone in a bare yard before a modest single-story house. A thin rectangular border encloses the scene, leaving a narrow pale margin outside it. The upper sky is largely white, interrupted by a dark leafy canopy hanging from the left corner and a lighter tree crown rising behind the roof at the right. Across the middle, the house stretches horizontally with a low pitched roof, chimney, dark windows, and a small projecting gable. A utility pole and wires stand to the left, while rough shrubs and scattered yard objects line the wall. The woman dominates the front center. She crouches low with knees raised together, elbows planted on them, and both hands pressed over her face. Thick curly dark hair spills around her fingers, hiding her eyes and expression. She wears a sleeveless patterned dark outfit over bare pale arms and closed light shoes with dark straps. Her compact posture and hidden face make the figure feel withdrawn and tense. The ground is a broad pale field of small black dots and gritty marks, with a hard dark shadow pooling to the lower left of her body. Off to the right, an indistinct small bundle rests on the ground. Fine black stippling, crosshatching, and short ink strokes give the roof, foliage, fabric, and earth different textures without color. Bright overhead sunlight makes the arms, sky, and ground almost white, while dense ink gathers in hair, clothing, trees, and under the figure. No readable lettering appears. The overall composition uses a large empty yard around the crouched figure, making an everyday setting feel emotionally heavy and still.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白点描插画呈现一名女子独自蹲在空旷院子里，身后是一座朴素的单层房屋。细矩形边框围住场景，外侧留有窄浅色边距。上方天空大部分是白色，左上角垂下一片深树冠，右侧屋顶后升起一片较浅的树冠。中部房屋横向延展，低矮的斜屋顶上有烟囱，墙上是深窗户，还伸出一小段三角山墙。左侧立着电线杆和电线，粗糙灌丛与零散院中物件沿墙排列。女子主导中央前景。她蹲得很低，双膝一起抬起，双肘撑在膝上，两只手紧紧捂住脸。浓密深色卷发散在手指周围，遮住眼睛与表情。她穿无袖深色花纹衣服，手臂浅色裸露，脚上是带深色鞋带的浅色包头鞋。紧缩的姿态与被遮住的脸让人物显得退缩而紧张。地面是一片宽阔的浅色区域，铺满细黑点和砂砾痕迹，一道硬边深影聚在她身体左下方。右侧地上还放着一小堆难辨的东西。细黑点描、交叉排线与短墨线让屋顶、树叶、衣料和土地拥有不同纹理，却没有色彩。明亮的顶光让手臂、天空与地面近乎白色，浓墨则聚在头发、服装、树木和人物下方。没有可读字样。整体构图用人物周围大片空旷院地，让日常场所显得情绪沉重而静止。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome illustration relies on stipple, short ink hatching, and carefully distributed black masses over a bright paper ground. Wide white areas sit beside dense textured shadows, producing strong contrast without smooth gradients. Small marks vary in size and direction to distinguish rough, soft, and patterned surfaces. Straight horizontal and rectangular forms are balanced by irregular organic clusters, while a compact dark focal mass occupies a much larger pale field. Hard cast shadows clarify physical grounding; distant elements have lighter, finer marks and less visual weight. The border and ample margins reinforce a printed-page quality. The overall effect is direct, gritty, and quietly dramatic, with emotional force coming from value placement, texture, and generous empty space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色插画依靠点描、短墨线排线和在明亮纸底上仔细分配的黑色块。宽阔白色区域紧邻密集纹理阴影，不用平滑渐层也能形成强对比。细小痕迹在大小与方向上变化，以区别粗糙、柔软和带花纹的表面。平直水平与矩形形态由不规则有机色团平衡，一块紧凑的暗焦点占据更大浅色场中的一小部分。硬投影明确物理落地关系；远处元素的笔痕更浅更细，视觉重量更低。边框与充足页边加强印刷纸页的质感。整体效果直接、粗粝而安静地富于戏剧性，情绪力量来自明度配置、纹理与大面积空白。
theme_en: A crouching woman hiding her face outside a modest house
theme_zh: 一名女子蹲在朴素房屋外，以双手遮住面容
name: Aline Kominsky-Crumb
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
